title: Data Analytics Trainer
description:
Job Description

1\. Experience in Technical Training/Teaching  
2\. Strong knowledge of Data Analytics, Machine Learning, Text Mining, Tableau, Power BI, and Advanced Excel  
3\. Conducting classes and practical data analytics for technical/engineering students  
4\. Should be able to describe the course content of the offered classes to students  
5\. Preference is given to certified trainers.

Requirements

1\. Mandatory: Graduation is a must. Computer Graduate who knows computers \& hardware well.  
2\. Past Experience/Skills Required (Mandatory)  
3\. Candidate should have strong technical skills/soft skills  
4\. Strong motivation to work in the social sector

5\. The person should be comfortable training students

6\. At least one year of experience in Training or Management

7\. Excellent Communication skills, Presentation skills. People handling skills

Pay: ₹34,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
